selection_reason: TA-24 is the most specific directly applicable Typical Application because the frozen facts establish a half-road closure on the far side of an intersection, with one direction remaining open. TA-8 and TA-20 were retrieved and inspected as detour-related alternatives, but they are broader detour-signing applications and do not better describe the primary traffic operation. The unresolved detour details affect later requirement applicability and augmentation, not selection of the primary TA.
